recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It narrowly completes the requested FHIRPath cleanup in active StructureDefinition source without changing or weakening the related CodeableReference conformance policy.
issue_request: FHIR-37761 was a Published FHIR-core technical correction resolved Persuasive. It asked to fix the StructureDefinition sdf-24 and sdf-25 constraints, noting that the expressions should not use $this and that a more straightforward form should avoid substrings.
initial_application: FHIR-31759 introduced sdf-24 and sdf-25 with id.substring(0,$this.length()-...) comparisons. FHIR-37761 was explicitly applied in commit 2cc91c21fca7fa12a0d60457be87e8ec2e123d2a, which changed those expressions to path.substring(0,$this.path.length()-...) and added failing invariant fixtures. That fixed the invalid id/$this.length() form but left the no-$this/no-substring cleanup incomplete in current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps structuredefinition to StructureDefinition and lists StructureDefinition as a conformance resource, so the edited XML is current build-scoped source. Later Published CodeableReference decisions, including FHIR-39176 and the already-published FHIR-38957 reconciliation on the combined branch, preserve the SHALL NOT policy enforced by sdf-24 and sdf-25. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence for FHIR-37761 was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml so sdf-24 and sdf-25 use replaceMatches-based parent-path checks instead of $this.path.length() with substring arithmetic. The rule remains that targetProfile and binding constraints belong on CodeableReference, not on CodeableReference.reference or CodeableReference.concept.
source_changes: source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml: replaced the sdf-24 parent path derivation with a replaceMatches-based check for .reference child paths.
source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml: replaced the sdf-25 parent path derivation with a replaceMatches-based check for .concept child paths.
